//: Isolated STANDALONE typecheck for the Vetrina library (design doc §13). It compiles ONLY the framework-free core with DOM libs and `types: []` — no repo tsconfig, no @types/node, no React. If the core ever grows a dependency on the host, or on a non-DOM ambient type, this fails: the mechanical proof that Vetrina is publishable as-is. Run: `npm run check:vetrina`. The import-boundary gate (tools/check-ownership.js) guards runtime imports; this guards the type surface.
